title: Tinderwick Beacon - The Beacon Stair (SNES register)
_note: Tower-climb cue for all three floors of the Tinderwick Beacon (the wick-key ascent, wick-tender sight trainers on the stairs, Brisa's bond-test at the lantern). The STAIR is the bass: a four-note stepwise climb played twice per bar, each bar starting one step higher (D-E-F-G, then on), so the music literally ascends; the bridge climbs higher still (Bb-C-D) before an A-major landing pulls back to the next flight. Determined pulse25 lead calls from bar 1 beat 3 (a rising fourth). Warm Ember BRASS stabs on the downbeats, a BELL glint at each phrase top (the lamp far above), a march snare with tom fills at each landing. snes era. 104 BPM, 4/4, D Dorian (B natural is the colour; A major as the pull home). 16 bars. Steady resolve with a thread of tension.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: The call: A4->D5 rising fourth over the first step, answered by the Dorian B natural on the G landing. A' climbs higher; B peaks on A5 at bar 11; last bar B4->C#5 leans back into the call.
